meta.title: Twenty Eleven Showcase Slider — Live Preview
meta.author: obenland
meta.description: Sticky featured posts auto-rotate on the Twenty Eleven Showcase template.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );

$entries = array(
	array( 'The Quiet Mountains',     array( 90, 110, 130 ) ),
	array( 'A City After Rain',       array( 70, 90, 110 ) ),
	array( 'Morning at the Harbor',   array( 200, 150, 80 ) ),
	array( 'Across the Open Plains',  array( 160, 140, 100 ) ),
	array( 'Light Through the Trees', array( 110, 140, 90 ) ),
);

$uploads = wp_upload_dir();
$sticky  = array();

foreach ( $entries as $i => $entry ) {
	list( $title, $rgb ) = $entry;

	$post_id = wp_insert_post( array(
		'post_title'   => $title,
		'post_content' => 'A featured story to demonstrate the Twenty Eleven Showcase Slider carousel.',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_type'    => 'post',
	) );

	/*
	 * GD-generated placeholder so the preview looks like a real showcase
	 * without needing outbound network access. 1000x288 matches the
	 * theme's `feature-image large` threshold so each post lays out as
	 * the wide hero variant.
	 */
	$image = imagecreatetruecolor( 1000, 288 );
	$bg    = imagecolorallocate( $image, $rgb[0], $rgb[1], $rgb[2] );
	imagefilledrectangle( $image, 0, 0, 1000, 288, $bg );
	$ink   = imagecolorallocate( $image, 255, 255, 255 );
	$x     = (int) ( ( 1000 - imagefontwidth( 5 ) * strlen( $title ) ) / 2 );
	imagestring( $image, 5, $x, 130, $title, $ink );

	$filename = 'showcase-' . ( $i + 1 ) . '.png';
	$path     = trailingslashit( $uploads['path'] ) . $filename;
	imagepng( $image, $path );
	imagedestroy( $image );

	$attachment_id = wp_insert_attachment(
		array(
			'post_mime_type' => 'image/png',
			'post_title'     => $title,
			'post_status'    => 'inherit',
		),
		$path,
		$post_id
	);
	wp_update_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id, $path ) );
	set_post_thumbnail( $post_id, $attachment_id );

	$sticky[] = $post_id;
}

update_option( 'sticky_posts', $sticky );

$page_id = wp_insert_post( array(
	'post_title'   => 'Showcase',
	'post_content' => '',
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_type'    => 'page',
	'meta_input'   => array( '_wp_page_template' => 'showcase.php' ),
) );

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_id );

flush_rewrite_rules();
